blind_spots: 124,624 executable bytes are outside the closure range union and 204,740 are outside generated-function union.
4,526 accepted-closure indirect sites are not globally resolvable by a direct-call search.
Two recovered PM4 indirect-buffer builders can submit payload content that is not statically decoded by this bounded phase.
Two metadata-driven LOAD_ALU_CONSTANT helpers choose selector type from runtime resource records, so static code cannot prove whether a given record is texture FETCH type 1.
Dynamic code/data mutation and runtime packet frequency are outside a static experiment.

search_strategies.scope: All 60,425 generated functions plus closure and Ghidra references for 0x82BA77D0.
search_strategies.result: Exactly two generated direct calls, from 0x82BA7B28 at 0x82BA81CC and 0x82BA83C0 at 0x82BA85D8; no exact-target thunk or data/table reference.
search_strategies.limitation: An unresolved computed target that never materializes the exact address cannot be identified as a caller.

search_strategies.scope: Whole generated corpus for constructed Type 3 PM4_SET_CONSTANT, LOAD_ALU_CONSTANT, SET_CONSTANT2, SET_SHADER_CONSTANTS, LOAD_CONSTANT_CONTEXT and SET_STATE headers.
search_strategies.result: One explicit SET_CONSTANT FETCH producer, three dynamic LOAD_ALU helpers, and three SET_STATE record builders; false hits were rejected by header-high and following-store checks.
search_strategies.limitation: Prebuilt or runtime-loaded packet payloads are opaque.

search_strategies.scope: Whole generated corpus for Type 0 headers covering register range 0x4800..0x48FF, then six-word descriptor type decoding.
search_strategies.result: Four real header constructors: one texture producer and three vertex-only producers.
search_strategies.limitation: A header assembled without a recoverable immediate may evade this syntactic search.

search_strategies.scope: All LOAD_ALU_CONSTANT call sites, selector arithmetic and constant argument pairs.
search_strategies.result: sub_8227D150 is bounded to ALU type 0 at all ten call sites; sub_82221B90 and sub_8222BFA0 take selector types from runtime metadata and remain texture-capable but unresolved.
search_strategies.limitation: Resource metadata values are not embedded in code and payload capture is prohibited.

search_strategies.scope: Closure candidates, Ghidra references, generated lis/addi materializations, recovered pointer runs and jump-table targets.
search_strategies.result: No exact address-taken reference to SXDK-001; SXDK-003 is materialized at 0x82BAA338/0x82BAA358 into a callback registration record.
search_strategies.limitation: The registrar dispatcher is an unresolved virtual call, so invocation thread and record retention are unknown.

search_strategies.scope: Callers of common state producer sub_8221B010 and downstream DRAW_INDX packet construction.
search_strategies.result: Six accepted-closure state-to-draw segments bypass SXDK-001 and route through metadata-driven sub_8222BFA0.
search_strategies.limitation: Static names do not identify character, terrain, particles, UI, video, post-processing or shadow membership.

search_strategies.scope: Pinned ReXGlue and Canary command processors and Xenos register definitions.
search_strategies.result: Selector type 1 is texture FETCH, type 3 is vertex FETCH; SET_STATE has an enum but no executor/dispatch implementation in either pinned reference.
search_strategies.limitation: Reference behavior does not prove Fable II route execution.

historical_artifact_limitation.treatment: User-confirmed historical deletion before G1.6A. The files were not searched for, recovered, recreated or substituted. Aggregate --verify-artifacts may fail only these existing G1.5D artifact checks; focused G1.6B inputs are verified separately.

phase_decision.reason: A correct six-dword texture seam with two direct callers cannot represent ordinary title rendering when another confirmed texture writer and a six-root state-to-draw family bypass it, and the remaining dynamic paths are unresolved rather than evidence of broad coverage.
